content:
Jess (CS): Heads-up — assembling a focused week of office hours for the Ensemble account (onboarding + renewal-risk mitigation). Need volunteers for facilitator slots and any must-have agenda items.
Mike C: I can take Wed 9:00am PT (16:00 UTC). Happy to run the dedicated -> private migration overview and migration checklist walk-through.
Sarah S: I’ll take a follow-up workshop on evals and quality monitoring — Fri 11:00am PT (18:00 UTC). I’ll also capture questions to send to the customer before the session.
Devon: Can we carve out one session specifically for their infra team on VPC/on-prem networking? Prefer Tue 8:00am PT (15:00 UTC). I can lead.
Tia Ops: Heads-up on timezones — APAC stakeholders asked for a late-night slot (02:00 UTC). Suggest we record one session and offer a 11:00pm PT (06:00 UTC) office hour for APAC. Also: we should include a renewal signal checklist in every session.
Onboard Bot: Reminder: add calendar invites with subject tag "Ensemble Enablement — Office Hours" and apply /invite-template. Auto-add notes: onboarding runbook link + ticket list.
Jess (CS): Draft agenda: 1) onboarding status & blockers, 2) migration checklist (network, KMS, SSO), 3) performance tuning & cost optimization playbook, 4) renewal health & next steps, 5) feedback capture. Any changes?
Luca (Solutions): Add a short segment (10 min) under perf tuning for batching/caching recommendations and quantization tradeoffs. Also propose a 3-question survey to capture session usefulness — I’ll draft it.
Mike C: For invites, calendar description snippet suggestion: ```Join Redwood enablement session. Pre-reads: onboarding runbook (link), open tickets. Bring: infra diagram, SSO contact. Session will be recorded and a short survey will be sent.```
Sarah S: I'll own post-session follow-up and feedback capture. Can we use the quick survey: 3 questions (helpful? blockers? next requested topics)? I’ll link it in the calendar.
Jess (CS): :thumbsup: Action items consolidated — Mike: Wed 16:00 UTC migration session; Devon: Tue 15:00 UTC infra session; Sarah: Fri 18:00 UTC evals + survey; Luca: draft survey & perf notes; Tia: add renewal checklist doc to drive. I’ll send calendar invites today.
Devon: Network playbook added to shared drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/ensemble/network-playbook. Also I’ll ping @eng-runtime for a 15-min perf readout during the Friday slot.
Mike C: :white_check_mark: Calendar invites sent (with agenda + pre-read links). Please accept and add attendee notes.
Sarah S: Preparing a short slide deck and a single slide with renewal risk mitigations and suggested next milestones.
Jess (CS): Thanks all. Quick note — flagged Ensemble from green -> yellow on renewal risk due to slow Dedicated adoption; we want to ensure clear migration wins in these sessions and capture adoption metrics in the CS tracker. I’ll update the tracker after the sessions.
